name: java-upgrade-desktop-agent
description: Windows desktop agent for Maven Java upgrades via GitHub Copilot CLI

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json -w --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:5174 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5174 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml && npm run apply:exe-icon
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --config electron-builder.yml && npm run apply:exe-icon
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.portable.yml
